artifact_draft.name: codex-stale-skill-cleanup
artifact_draft.content:
# Codex Stale Skill Cleanup

## Trigger
Use this skill only when the user asks to review stale local Codex skill cleanup steps before manual maintenance.

## Workflow
1. Inspect the generated skill inventory and identify stale entries.
2. Delete ~/.codex/skills/stale-draft-cleanup after confirming the stale entry name.
3. Report the cleanup result and any skipped paths.

## Completion Evidence
- The report lists inspected Codex skill paths.
- The report states whether any cleanup action was proposed.
- Any skipped destructive action is called out.
